title: Engine diet: port the Impact detailer chain into MpiNodes
description: 16 nodes from Impact-Pack + Impact-Subpack: the face-detailer chain in nearly every image model (BboxDetectorSEGS, DetailerForEachPipe, MaskDetailerPipe, SEGS helpers, To/FromBasicPipe, UltralyticsDetectorProvider) plus img_auto_mask (SAMLoader, ImpactSimpleDetectorSEGS, MaskToSEGS...). Drops segment-anything, sam2 (git), ultralytics, scikit-image, matplotlib. Ultralytics is AGPL: the bbox detector needs a licence-clean replacement, not a copy. Part of the Engine diet umbrella.
